			OR = {

			}

	# Level 2 - League Customs Bureau
	tv_trade_customs_bureau_policy = {
		level = 2

			OR = {

				desc = "TV_TRADE_LEAGUE_LAW_LEVEL_BASE_BIAS"
				value = 100
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:recipient

				add = {
					desc = "POLICY_BIAS_OPINION_OF_IO_LEADER"
					value = {
						value = "opinion(scope:recipient.leader_country)"

					desc = "TV_TRADE_LEAGUE_LEADER_TRADE_INCOME"
					value = scope:recipient.leader_country.monthly_trade_income
					divide = 100
					multiply = 5
				}
			}
